    activityDisplayName="*Certificates and secrets management*" 
| eval upn='initiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName', appname='initiatedBy.app.displayName' 
| eval actor=case(isnotnull(upn) AND upn!="null", upn, isnotnull(appname) AND appname!="null", appname, true(), "unknown") 
| eval target_app=mvindex('targetResources{}.displayName',0), target_id=mvindex('targetResources{}.id',0), operation=trim(activityDisplayName), src_ip='initiatedBy.user.ipAddress' 
| rex field="targetResources{}.modifiedProperties{}.newValue" "KeyType=(?<key_type>\w+)" 
| eval key_type=coalesce(key_type,"not logged"), cred_context=if(like(operation,"Create application%"),"added at app creation","added to existing app") 
| lookup entra_known_apps.csv target_id OUTPUT approved_actor 
| where isnull(approved_actor) OR approved_actor!=actor 
| stats earliest(_time) as _time values(operation) as operation values(key_type) as key_type values(cred_context) as cred_context values(src_ip) as src_ip by correlationId actor target_app target_id
